base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN m.XCL_010 END)
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
WHERE a.XCL_003 IN ('i', 's')
  AND b.XCL_006 = '-';
